text:
sam: incident-bot paged me for elevated queue times on runtime-hosted in us-west-2, rolling 5m p95 spiking to 2.4s and a few 429s seen. paging noise from customers A/B.
incident-bot: [ALERT] runtime-queue-delay high on service=runtime-hosted region=us-west-2 severity=page rule=runtime_queue_p95 threshold=2.0s
maria: seeing a correlate in inflight_count on the priority lane — max_inflight at 120, autoscale lagging. some tenants (tenant-id: alpha-corp, beta-startup) show repeated timeouts.
jordan: confirmed. running quick query: `select tenant, count(*) from requests where status=429 and region='us-west-2' group by tenant limit 5` — alpha-corp ~180 errs last 5m, beta ~65. latency also higher for embeddings route.
sam: initial mitigation plan: 1) lower max_inflight for hosted runtime on us-west-2 from 120 -> 80 2) enable aggressive shedding for low-priority lanes (shedding_policy=idle-first, target_eviction_ms=60000) 3) bump tenant QPS for alpha-corp temporarily to reduce retries (graceful quota bump) 4) disable non-critical realtime quantize path if CPU spikes. agree?
maria: +1 on inflight reduction. set my flags: `max_inflight=80` and `shedding_mode=soft` so we get graceful fails. also add `eviction_window=60s`.
dave: be careful with quota bump — that could mask underlying perf issues. recommend temporary bump to alpha-corp only and push customers to backoff header. I'll message cust success.
jordan: executing inflight change now on canary fleet. command: ``kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n runtime --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_inflight":"80","eviction_window":"60s","shedding_policy":"idle-first"}}'``
sam: canary rollout acked — 3 nodes, no crash. monitoring p95 — dropped from 2.4s -> 1.6s after ~45s. 429 count for alpha-corp falling.
incident-bot: [INFO] config-change applied by jordan at 7141592690: max_inflight=80, eviction_window=60s, shedding_policy=idle-first
maria: next step: enable soft-shed on embeddings-heavy route `/v1/embeddings` for best-effort tenants; keep prod-tier pinned. I'll flip the traffic-shaper to deprioritize best-effort.
dave: sending customer note to alpha-corp CS: "We observed transient queue backpressure; we applied a targeted config change to reduce head-of-line times and temporarily increased your QPS to avoid retries. We'll follow up with a postmortem."
sam: also toggled `request_timeout` from 45s -> 30s for best-effort lanes to avoid long tails — that'll reduce KV cache pressure.
jordan: telemetry shows inflight per-tenant now within expected bounds. need to watch for secondary effects: slightly higher reject for very long requests.
maria: recording mitigation steps in incident tracker. tagging oncall-runbook: `runtime-backpressure` and setting severity -> incident. will hand off to dave for investigation and postmortem.
dave: picking up. will dig into autoscaler logs and kernel selection path for embeddings; schedule 1:1 with runtime team in 30m.
sam: thanks all. leaving channel but will be reachable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: [RESOLVE] alert muted by manual mitigation at 7141592773 — runtime p95 reduced below threshold in us-west-2
dave: follow-ups: 1) revert temporary quota bump after 2 hours if stable 2) add finer-grained shedding telemetry 3) review slow request traces for alpha-corp and beta-startup. assigning tickets.
maria: noted. I'll add the telemetry dashboards and a synthetic test for embeddings route in us-west-2.
sam: closing handoff — dave you own the postmortem. ping me if you need logs or dashboards.
